notes.title: Next Fest summary📃✨ Your questions❓
notes.content:
Dear students, we have some fantastic news to share with you! Let's dive right in:

[h3]Steam Next Fest -  February 2024[/h3]

We want to express our gratitude to all the amazing players who participated in the Steam Next Fest in February. 🎮✨ Over 8000 of you downloaded the demo, and we are thrilled to announce that nearly 660 players have already given it a try! The average playtime of the demo so far is 25 minutes, and we have received an overwhelming 20 bug reports. 🐛🔍 Rest assured, we are diligently working through them to improve the game based on your valuable feedback. Thank you all for your support! 🤝✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44815993/34dd4a4d7bc5187d25915cce5e1da83033e3bf67.png[/img]

[h3]What Do You Want to Know 🤔🔍?[/h3]
We value your curiosity and want to address all your burning questions about Secret School! 🤔✨ [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2526360/discussions/3/]Leave a comment[/url] and let us know what interests you the most. Your feedback and inquiries mean the world to us!

[h3] Share your own opinion about "Secret School" 📺:[/h3]
Your thoughts 💭 and experiences are incredibly valuable to us and other players. We have created a [url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1bbplUkkp6xFc8bJ7I9nOTFIRU5mizj28?usp=drive_link]Content Creator Kit[/url] where every influencer/creator gets all the information and assets for the game in one place. Showcase your exciting experiences to the world!

Thank you for being a part of this amazing community. Let's continue to uncover the secrets of the school together. Stay tuned for further updates! 🎉✨💫

Your team of Secret School

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2526360/Secret_School

notes.title: New FREE demo is coming!🎉
notes.content:
